create_Link: create a Link object with a given link name for URDF parsing
addVisual_to_Link: add a Visual object to a Link's visuals list with an optional name
setVisualMeshScale: set the mesh scale of the most recently added visual on a Link
setVisualOriginXyz: set the xyz origin position of the most recently added visual on a Link
setVisualGeometryMeshFilename: set the mesh filename for the most recently added visual on a Link
